items.text: Final report: Carolina ruled out OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring), LG Damien Lewis (knee), CB Akayleb Evans (triceps/knee) and OL Torricelli Simpkins III (ankle); DT Bobby Brown III (hand) is questionable. The team says it has seven healthy offensive linemen and two healthy cornerbacks. Bryce Young (ankle) has no designation.
Carolina is also without RT Taylor Moton (fibula, IR), LT Ikem Ekwonu (season) and CB Jaycee Horn (torn quad, headed to IR).

Final report: Green Bay ruled out LB Zaire Franklin (shin), RG Travis Glover (knee) and C Sean Rhyan (ankle); WR Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot), DT Devonte Wyatt (ankle), DT Anthony Campbell (ankle) and Edge Brenton Cox (quad) are questionable. Kevin Zeitler or Mekhi Becton at RG, John Williams likely at C.
Thursday: CB Keisean Nixon (shoulder) was added to the report as questionable.
Edge Micah Parsons is on reserve/PUP and will not play; a return is targeted for weeks later. Golden is a game-time call after limited Wednesday work.

adjust.reason: Carolina is down to two healthy cornerbacks without Horn and Evans and is missing OLB Phillips, LG Lewis and RT Moton, which outweighs Green Bay's two interior-line starters and LB Franklin. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
